text:
Nina Park: Quick flag in the API ref is wrong for POST /v1/generate. The curl example shows ?include_metadata=\"true\" (quoted) which the server treats as a string and some SDKs return 400.

Omar Velazquez: Yikes. Can you paste the snippet?

Nina Park: Current snippet:
```
curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?include_metadata=\"true\"' \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-large","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Server expects unquoted boolean or body param.

Samir Rao: I'll open a docs PR to fix the curl and the Node fetch example to put include_metadata: true in the JSON body. Will add a one-line migration note under the param: "Avoid quoted booleans in querystring; prefer body boolean or unquoted flag."

Nina Park: Thanks. Also add a short callout in the endpoint overview: "Boolean query flags must be unquoted."

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1399 - "docs(generate): fix include_metadata example and migration note"

Omar Velazquez: Ran the updated curl against staging, returned 200. LGTM from API side.

Samir Rao: Merged to main after copy edits. Closing thread.
